Week 12 Jaguars Outlook: Robert Saleh and DC Gus Bradley open installation for the Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3, JAX -14.5, HC Liam Coen, OC Grant Udinski & DC Anthony Campanile (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Def. EPA Allowed / Game (-5.86) as Tennessee prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Jeremy Brener](https://www.musiccitymiracles.com/tennessee-titans-news/68073/tennessee-titans-news-week-12-vs-jaguars-provides-hope).

rawStream.fullText:
Statement from @Titans:

Yesterday, Jaylen Harrell was involved in a serious car accident that resulted in him being taken to the hospital in his hometown of Tampa, Florida. We have been in constant communication with Jaylen’s family and are still working to gather more information. At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care. We ask that Jaylen and his family’s privacy be respected at this time. We will provide an update when appropriate.

rawStream.author: Jim Wyatt
